reviews.title: Great renewed motherboard
reviews.comment: Works great and looks almost new. It came with a 3D printed IO shield, 2 replacement WIFI antennas and 2 SATA cables. The packaging was decent and the motherboard was in an anti static bag and its all clean, no dirt dust hair ECT.
reviews.author: Honeybee33

reviews.title: Awesome for the price
reviews.comment: Works perfectly and came with a ton of accessories. Only complaint is that the 3d printed io shield wouldn’t stay on the case so I had to hold it in while I put in the motherboard, but thats really a nitpick.
reviews.author: Evin Carroll

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.comment: Bought a renewed mobo, seems to be great
reviews.author: Cat

reviews.title: Muy bien
reviews.comment: Para ser reacondicionada no le encontré ningún defecto salvo que no vino con su antena de WiFi original de Asus, y que no vino con su chapa metálica original, aunque si vino con una impresa en 3d con las medidas exactas y de buena calidad, personalmente me gusta porque al ser color negro va acordé con mi pc, a nivel hardware y software 0 problemas, excelente rendimiento.
reviews.author: José Rubén
